description.fallback: The Joestar group finds out the whole town in which they spent the night was made of illusions by Justice, and every resident was actually a corpse. The group decides to bring Enya with them until they can find a TV and use Hermit Purple to read her mind. This way, they will have the advantage by stealing information about DIO and his remaining mercenaries from her.
